messages:
mina: Quick q — I'm planning to return from parental leave on 2026-07-12 with a 6-week reduced schedule: weeks 1-2 at 50%, weeks 3-4 at 70%, weeks 5-6 at 90%. Also need to be in UK for 9 days during week 2 for family onboarding. What paperwork, approvals, and timeline do I need?

jules (People Ops): Congrats, Mina! Please complete the Reduced Schedule (Phased Return) form under HR > Leaves & Return and the Remote Work Abroad mini-form for your UK stay. We need at least 10 business days to process to sync with payroll.

mina: If I set the 50% week as Mon/Wed only, and 70% as 4 days, do PTO accruals change?

payroll-bot: PTO accrual will be prorated to your scheduled FTE each pay period during the phased return. Holiday pay is prorated based on scheduled workdays. Use payroll code PARENT_PHASE so payroll system calculates correctly.

raj: Heads up — remote work in the UK <10 days typically doesn't create tax nexus, but People Ops needs the exact dates. Also add device and VPN plan on the form; Security will confirm if any EU/UK data safeguards are needed.

jules (People Ops): Stipend note: Family Support Stipend up to $750 for short-term childcare/schooling can be requested with receipts within 30 days after the phased period. It's discretionary and tied to an approved phased return.

mina: Timeline: I'll submit forms today. Anything else for manager approval?

jules (People Ops): Manager approval required in the portal. Also please add a short coverage note for critical deliverables and on-call commitments on the form or in the calendar invite. We'll ping payroll once approved to adjust pay and benefits.

mina: Thanks — submitting now.

jules (People Ops): Thanks! Tag me after submission and I'll expedite review. (reaction :rocket:)
